props.caption: Khasab, Oman. The incident report and Iran’s MQ-9 claim remain separate accounts.

lead.what: Countries agreed to elaborate a possible accord on lethal autonomous weapons systems by 2028 without committing to binding rules.

rest.what: Saudi civil defence lifted an aerial-threat alert after two explosions were heard in Riyadh.

lead.what: UKMTO received a report of an incident 11 nautical miles north of Khasab, while Iran claimed it downed an MQ-9 over the strait.

rest.what: Oracle says the OpenAI infrastructure commitment is fully financed.

lead.what: Bitcoin fell 5.10% to $55,830, its lowest level since September 2024.

rest.what: Countries remained deadlocked as negotiations ran overnight, without a new global climate deal.
